purpose: Expanded exploratory real-case search with all outcomes retained; not confirmatory efficacy estimation
gold_blinding: Fresh no-history prediction and score agents; instructional file whitelist, shared filesystem not OS isolation; preparation reads annotations solely for later evaluation, outputs evaluated only after freeze
source_refresh: Original metadata returned 403; web reader recognized CDCP zip but cannot read zip; shell DNS blocked and escalated GitHub API returned HTTP403. Existing archives match saved provenance hashes; original AAEC versus mirror byte equality remains unverified.
evaluation: Exact original character boundaries/types and complete typed native relations; same evaluator as initial 16; all selected documents including failures stay in denominators
candidate_protocol: finite union of 2 Luna graph outputs; supplemental labels/slots specified and frozen before scoring; deviations from exhaustive thesis universe will be enumerated
scoring_protocol: separate gold-blind Luna scoring call; fixed per-object confidence as a heuristic proxy, not calibrated probability and not the trained MLP scorer from thesis
case_selection: fixed rule after full evaluation: first doc ID of improvement, harm, unchanged; enumerate unavailable categories

continuation.positive_primary: strict complete relation F1 > MCR-only; separately identify recovered-TP cases and improvement beyond RelationOnly
continuation.selection_of_cases: lexicographic first per outcome, plus lexicographic first TP-recovery and BRJ-over-RelationOnly cases; list all positive IDs
continuation.extension_trigger: After completing all first-wave documents, if a corpus has no strict relation F1 improvement, expand only that corpus by the next 4 ranks per length stratum (up to 16 documents per complete wave), preserving all prior outcomes
continuation.stop: Stop once both corpora contain an improvement after a completed wave, or each lacking-positive corpus exhausts its preordered unique audit-text pool; never tune scores or redraw candidates using gold
continuation.inference_limit: Outcome-adaptive expansion is case discovery; no significance testing, generalization, or independent-test claim

previous_pilot.reuse: Existing 16 predictions, scores and results reused byte-for-byte; new 48 run separately; combined totals clearly split by wave

scope_changes: Only sample size and task grouping change; candidate constructor, default 0.05, repair functions, budgets and prompt task definitions unchanged
